post_export_processing.reason: The generic exporter compares the extracted answer to the gold string. For answer_form: plan that is invalid -- one plan has many spellings and independent actions may be ordered differently -- so it reported all 10 as unsolved. Each plan was re-graded by executing it from the initial state and checking it reaches the goal. Fields overwritten: no_update_solved, answer_extraction_method, plan_actions.
